facts.fact: Hespress English, citing a Global Finance report, states that a 2021 law mandates sensitive data be stored locally in Morocco; the date is the article's published date, and the article gives no law name.
facts.system: 2021 law mandating local storage of sensitive data (unnamed)

note: Article only says the law has spurred data repatriation, with no organisation named or counted, so no fact on use.
